AIPredictionAssociation_Abridged.description: Collection of model prediction associations related to this prediction. An association gives context and meaning to a prediction.

assocEntityId.description: Identifier of the entity involved in this association, if applicable.

assocData.description: Specifies what data is associated to the prediction (e.g., DOCUMENT, IMAGE, URN ADDRESS, etc.).

assocType.description: Specifies what type of data is associated to the prediction (e.g., EXPLANATION, INPUT, REFERENCE, etc.).

assocContext.description: Describes why the data is associated to the prediction.

assocDataKeys.description: Array of keys that provide specific details about the data associated to the prediction, such as bounding box coordinates, time ranges, feature weights, etc. The entries in this array must correspond to the position index in the assocDataValues and assocDataUofMs arrays. This array must be the same length as assocDataValues and assocDataUofMs.

assocDataValues.description: Array of values for the assocDataKeys that provide specific details about the data associated to the prediction, such as bounding box coordinates, time ranges, feature weights, etc. The entries in this array must correspond to the position index in the assocDataKeys and assocDataUofMs arrays. This array must be the same length as assocDataKeys and assocDataUofMs.

assocDataUofMs.description: Array of units for the assocDataValues that provide specific details about the data associated to the prediction, such as bounding box coordinates, time ranges, feature weights, etc. The entries in this array must correspond to the position index in the assocDataKeys and assocDataValues arrays. This array must be the same length as assocDataKeys and assocDataValues. If there are no physical units associated with the assocDataValues, a value of NONE should be specified.

assocTimestamp.description: Datetime the association between the data and the prediction was established, in ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision.

elementType.description: The type of element the explanation data describes (e.g., FEATURE, REGION, TOKEN, etc.).

elementName.description: Identifies the element being explained (AGE, SIZE, VOLTAGE, etc.).

elementValue.description: Value associated with the element, expressed in the specified unit of measure (elementUoM).

impactScore.description: Measured impact the element had on the prediction. Positive values are associated with a higher prediction probability, while negative values are associated with a lower prediction probability.

explanationDataNotes.description: Notes associated with the explanation data.

AIPredictionContentUncertainty_Abridged.description: Collection of model prediction uncertainties related to the prediction content. An uncertainty is a measure of how uncertain the AI model is about a specific prediction output.

uncertCategory.description: Category of the source of uncertainty affecting the prediction, such as data noise or limited model knowledge (e.g., ALEATORIC, EPISTEMIC, MIXED).

uncertType.description: The statistical or mathematical representation of the uncertainty for the prediction (e.g., CONFIDENCE INTERVAL, STANDARD DEVIATION, VARIANCE, etc.).

uncertDescription.description: Describes the type of uncertainty being reported.
uncertDescription.example: Amount of variability of solar array performance metrics.

uncertMethod.description: Describes the method or process used to calculate the uncertainty values (e.g., BOOTSTRAP, ENSEMBLE, MC DROPOUT, etc.).

confidenceLevel.description: Probability the true value is within the given lowerBound and upperBound, expressed as a percent. The range of values is 0 to 100, with 100 being highest level of confidence.

lowerBound.description: The smallest value in the confidence interval for the prediction.

upperBound.description: The largest value in the confidence interval for the prediction.

ensembleMethod.description: The approach used if multiple models are combined (e.g., BAGGING, STACKING, etc.).

ensembleSize.description: Number of models in the ensemble.

samplingMethod.description: The method used to collect samples (e.g., BOOTSTRAP, MONTE CARLO, etc.).

samplingCount.description: Number of predictions or samples used to calculate the uncertainty values.

seeds.description: List of random number starting values used.

calibrationTechnique.description: Method used to adjust prediction probabilities (e.g., ISOTONIC, NONE, PLATT, TEMPERATURE SCALING, etc.).

calibrationParameter.description: The main numeric value used by the calibration technique.

ece.description: Expected Calibration Error score. Measures the average difference between predicted probabilities and actual outcomes. Lower values indicate more accurate and calibrated predictions.

brierScore.description: Brier score for probability accuracy. Calculates the mean squared difference between predicted probabilities and actual outcomes. Lower scores indicate more accurate and calibrated predictions.

nll.description: Negative Log-Likelihood score. Measures how unlikely the observed data is under the predicted probability distribution. Lower values indicate better agreement between predictions and actual outcomes.

uncertKeys.description: Array of keys that provide specific details about uncertainty elements associated to the prediction content. The entries in this array must correspond to the position index in the uncertValues and uncertUofMs arrays. This array must be the same length as uncertValues and uncertUofMs.

uncertValues.description: Array of values for the uncertKeys that provide specific details about uncertainty elements associated to the prediction content. The entries in this array must correspond to the position index in the uncertKeys and uncertUofMs arrays. This array must be the same length as uncertKeys and uncertUofMs.

uncertUofMs.description: Array of units for the uncertValues that provide specific details about uncertainty elements associated to the prediction content. The entries in this array must correspond to the position index in the uncertKeys and uncertValues arrays. This array must be the same length as uncertKeys and uncertValues. If there are no physical units associated with the uncertValues, a value of NONE should be specified.

uncertNotes.description: Notes associated with this uncertainty data.

AIS_Abridged.description: Self-reported information obtained from Automatic Identification System (AIS) equipment. This contains information such as unique identification, status, position, course, and speed. The AIS is an automatic tracking system that uses transceivers on ships and is used by vessel traffic services. Although technically and operationally distinct, the AIS system is analogous to ADS-B that performs a similar function for aircraft. AIS is intended to assist a vessel's watchstanding officers and allow maritime authorities to track and monitor vessel movements. AIS integrates a standardized VHF transceiver with a positioning system such as Global Positioning System receiver, with other electronic navigation sensors, such as gyrocompass or rate of turn indicator. Vessels fitted with AIS transceivers can be tracked by AIS base stations located along coast lines or, when out of range of terrestrial networks, through a growing number of satellites that are fitted with special AIS receivers which are capable of deconflicting a large number of signatures.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

mmsi.description: The Maritime Mobile Service Identity of the vessel.  MMSI is a nine-digit number that identifies the transmitter station of the vessel.

imon.description: The International Maritime Organization Number of the vessel.  IMON is a seven-digit number that uniquely identifies the vessel.

ts.description: The timestamp that the vessel position was recorded, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

shipName.description: The name of the vessel.  Vessel names that exceed the AIS 20 character are shortened (not truncated) to 15 character-spaces, followed by an underscore and the last 4 characters-spaces of the vessel full name.

shipType.description: The reported ship type (e.g. Passenger, Tanker, Cargo, Other, etc.).  See the engagedIn and specialCraft entries for additional information on certain types of vessels.

engagedIn.description: The activity that the vessel is engaged in.  This entry applies only when the shipType = Other.

specialCraft.description: The type of special craft designation of the vessel.  This entry applies only when the shipType = Special Craft.

cargoType.description: The reported cargo type. Intended as, but not constrained to, the USCG NAVCEN AIS cargo definitions. Users should refer to USCG Navigation Center documentation for specific definitions associated with ship and cargo types. USCG NAVCEN documentation may be found at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov.

callSign.description: A uniquely designated identifier for the vessel's transmitter station.

vesselFlag.description: The flag of the subject vessel according to AIS transmission.

lat.description: WGS-84 latitude of the vessel position, in degrees.  -90 to 90 degrees (negative values south of equator).

lon.description: WGS-84 longitude of the vessel position, in degrees.  -180 to 180 degrees (negative values west of Prime Meridian).

posHiAccuracy.description: Flag indicating high reported position accuracy (less than or equal to 10 meters).  A value of 0/false indicates low accuracy (greater than 10 meters).

posHiLatency.description: Flag indicating high reported position latency (greater than 5 seconds).  A value of 0/false indicates low latency (less than 5 seconds).

speed.description: The speed-over-ground reported by the vessel, in kilometers/hour.

trueHeading.description: The true heading reported by the vessel, in degrees.

course.description: The course-over-ground reported by the vessel, in degrees.

rateOfTurn.description: The Rate-of-Turn for the vessel, in degrees/minute.  Positive value indicates that the vessel is turning right.

specialManeuver.description: Flag indicating that the vessel is engaged in a special maneuver (e.g. Waterway Navigation).

navStatus.description: The AIS Navigational Status of the vessel (e.g. Underway Using Engine, Moored, Aground, etc.). Intended as, but not constrained to, the USCG NAVCEN navigation status definitions. Users should refer to USCG Navigation Center documentation for specific definitions associated with navigation status. USCG NAVCEN documentation may be found at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov.

posDeviceType.description: The type of electronic position fixing device (e.g. GPS, GLONASS, etc.). Intended as, but not constrained to, the USCG NAVCEN electronic position fixing device definitions. Users should refer to USCG Navigation Center documentation for specific device type information. USCG NAVCEN documentation may be found at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov.

antennaRefDimensions.description: The reference dimensions of the vessel, reported as [A, B, C, D], in meters.  Where the array values represent the distance fore (A), aft (B), to port (C), and to starboard (D) of the navigation antenna.  Array with values A = C = 0 and B, D > 0 indicate the length (B) and width (D) of the vessel without antenna position reference.

length.description: The overall length of the vessel, in meters.  A value of 511 indicates a vessel length of 511 meters or greater.

width.description: The breadth of the vessel, in meters.  A value of 63 indicates a vessel breadth of 63 meters or greater.

draught.description: The maximum static draught, in meters, of the vessel according to the AIS transmission.

shipDescription.description: Further description or explanation of the vessel or type.

destination.description: The destination of the vessel according to the AIS transmission.

destinationETA.description: The Estimated Time of Arrival of the vessel at the destination, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

currentPortGUID.description: The US Geographic Unique Identifier of the current port hosting the vessel.

currentPortLOCODE.description: The UN Location Code of the current port hosting the vessel.

lastPortGUID.description: The US Geographic Unique Identifier of the last port visited by the vessel.

lastPortLOCODE.description: The UN Location Code of the last port visited by the vessel.

nextPortGUID.description: The US Geographic Unique Identifier of the next destination port of the vessel.

nextPortLOCODE.description: The UN  Location Code of the next destination port of the vessel.

etaCalculated.description: The Estimated Time of Arrival of the vessel at the destination port, according to MarineTraffic calculations, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

etaUpdated.description: The date and time that the ETA was calculated by MarineTraffic, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

distanceToGo.description: The remaining distance, in kilometers, for the vessel to reach the reported destination.

distanceTravelled.description: The distance, in kilometers, that the vessel has travelled since departing the last port.

avgSpeed.description: The average speed, in kilometers/hour, calculated for the subject vessel during the latest voyage (port to port).

maxSpeed.description: The maximum speed, in kilometers/hour, reported by the subject vessel during the latest voyage (port to port).

Although technically and operationally distinct, the AIS system is analogous to ADS-B that performs a similar function for aircraft. AIS is intended to assist a vessel's watchstanding officers and allow maritime authorities to track and monitor vessel movements. AIS integrates a standardized VHF transceiver with a positioning system such as Global Positioning System receiver, with other electronic navigation sensors, such as gyrocompass or rate of turn indicator. Vessels fitted with AIS transceivers can be tracked by AIS base stations located along coast lines or, when out of range of terrestrial networks, through a growing number of satellites that are fitted with special AIS receivers which are capable of deconflicting a large number of signatures.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

mmsi.description: The Maritime Mobile Service Identity of the vessel.  MMSI is a nine-digit number that identifies the transmitter station of the vessel.

imon.description: The International Maritime Organization Number of the vessel.  IMON is a seven-digit number that uniquely identifies the vessel.

ts.description: The timestamp that the vessel position was recorded, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

shipName.description: The name of the vessel.  Vessel names that exceed the AIS 20 character are shortened (not truncated) to 15 character-spaces, followed by an underscore and the last 4 characters-spaces of the vessel full name.

shipType.description: The reported ship type (e.g. Passenger, Tanker, Cargo, Other, etc.).  See the engagedIn and specialCraft entries for additional information on certain types of vessels.

engagedIn.description: The activity that the vessel is engaged in.  This entry applies only when the shipType = Other.

specialCraft.description: The type of special craft designation of the vessel.  This entry applies only when the shipType = Special Craft.

cargoType.description: The reported cargo type. Intended as, but not constrained to, the USCG NAVCEN AIS cargo definitions. Users should refer to USCG Navigation Center documentation for specific definitions associated with ship and cargo types. USCG NAVCEN documentation may be found at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov.

callSign.description: A uniquely designated identifier for the vessel's transmitter station.

vesselFlag.description: The flag of the subject vessel according to AIS transmission.

lat.description: WGS-84 latitude of the vessel position, in degrees.  -90 to 90 degrees (negative values south of equator).

lon.description: WGS-84 longitude of the vessel position, in degrees.  -180 to 180 degrees (negative values west of Prime Meridian).

posHiAccuracy.description: Flag indicating high reported position accuracy (less than or equal to 10 meters).  A value of 0/false indicates low accuracy (greater than 10 meters).

posHiLatency.description: Flag indicating high reported position latency (greater than 5 seconds).  A value of 0/false indicates low latency (less than 5 seconds).

speed.description: The speed-over-ground reported by the vessel, in kilometers/hour.

trueHeading.description: The true heading reported by the vessel, in degrees.

course.description: The course-over-ground reported by the vessel, in degrees.

rateOfTurn.description: The Rate-of-Turn for the vessel, in degrees/minute.  Positive value indicates that the vessel is turning right.

specialManeuver.description: Flag indicating that the vessel is engaged in a special maneuver (e.g. Waterway Navigation).

navStatus.description: The AIS Navigational Status of the vessel (e.g. Underway Using Engine, Moored, Aground, etc.). Intended as, but not constrained to, the USCG NAVCEN navigation status definitions. Users should refer to USCG Navigation Center documentation for specific definitions associated with navigation status. USCG NAVCEN documentation may be found at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov.

posDeviceType.description: The type of electronic position fixing device (e.g. GPS, GLONASS, etc.). Intended as, but not constrained to, the USCG NAVCEN electronic position fixing device definitions. Users should refer to USCG Navigation Center documentation for specific device type information. USCG NAVCEN documentation may be found at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov.

antennaRefDimensions.description: The reference dimensions of the vessel, reported as [A, B, C, D], in meters.  Where the array values represent the distance fore (A), aft (B), to port (C), and to starboard (D) of the navigation antenna.  Array with values A = C = 0 and B, D > 0 indicate the length (B) and width (D) of the vessel without antenna position reference.

length.description: The overall length of the vessel, in meters.  A value of 511 indicates a vessel length of 511 meters or greater.

width.description: The breadth of the vessel, in meters.  A value of 63 indicates a vessel breadth of 63 meters or greater.

draught.description: The maximum static draught, in meters, of the vessel according to the AIS transmission.

shipDescription.description: Further description or explanation of the vessel or type.

destination.description: The destination of the vessel according to the AIS transmission.

destinationETA.description: The Estimated Time of Arrival of the vessel at the destination, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

currentPortLOCODE.description: The UN Location Code of the current port hosting the vessel.

lastPortGUID.description: The US Geographic Unique Identifier of the last port visited by the vessel.

lastPortLOCODE.description: The UN Location Code of the last port visited by the vessel.

nextPortGUID.description: The US Geographic Unique Identifier of the next destination port of the vessel.

nextPortLOCODE.description: The UN  Location Code of the next destination port of the vessel.

etaCalculated.description: The Estimated Time of Arrival of the vessel at the destination port, according to MarineTraffic calculations, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

etaUpdated.description: The date and time that the ETA was calculated by MarineTraffic, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

distanceToGo.description: The remaining distance, in kilometers, for the vessel to reach the reported destination.

distanceTravelled.description: The distance, in kilometers, that the vessel has travelled since departing the last port.

avgSpeed.description: The average speed, in kilometers/hour, calculated for the subject vessel during the latest voyage (port to port).

maxSpeed.description: The maximum speed, in kilometers/hour, reported by the subject vessel during the latest voyage (port to port).

fuelWeight.description: The weight of usable fuel on board the aircraft, in kilograms.

grossMoment.description: The sum of moments of all items making up the gross weight of the aircraft, in Newton-meters.

AirLoadPlan_Full.description: Information related to how an aircraft is loaded with cargo, equipment, and passengers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

externalId.description: Optional ID from external systems. This field has no meaning within UDL and is provided as a convenience for systems that require tracking of an internal system generated ID.

idMission.description: The UDL ID of the mission this record is associated with.

missionNumber.description: The mission number of the mission supporting this load plan.

idSortie.description: The UDL ID of the aircraft sortie this record is associated with.

legNum.description: The leg number of the mission supporting this load plan.

callSign.description: The call sign of the mission supporting this load plan.

tailNumber.description: The tail number of the aircraft supporting this load plan.

aircraftMDS.description: The Model Design Series designation of the aircraft supporting this load plan.

depICAO.description: The departure International Civil Organization (ICAO) code of the departure airfield.

depAirfield.description: Optional identifier of departure airfield with no International Civil Organization (ICAO) code.

estDepTime.description: The current estimated time that the aircraft is planned to depart, in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

arrICAO.description: The arrival International Civil Organization (ICAO) code of the landing airfield.

arrAirfield.description: Optional identifier of arrival airfield with no International Civil Organization (ICAO) code.

estArrTime.description: The current estimated time that the aircraft is planned to arrive, in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

crewSize.description: The number of crew members on the aircraft.

cargoConfig.description: The cargo configuration required for this leg (e.g. C-1, C-2, C-3, DV-1, DV-2, AE-1, etc.). Configuration meanings are determined by the data source.

equipConfig.description: Description of the equipment configuration (e.g. Standard, Ferry, JBLM, CHS, Combat, etc.). Configuration meanings are determined by the data source.

tankConfig.description: Description of the fuel tank(s) configuration (e.g. ER, NON-ER, etc.). Configuration meanings are determined by the data source.

basicWeight.description: The weight of the aircraft without passengers, cargo, equipment, or usable fuel, in kilograms.

basicMoment.description: The basic weight of the aircraft multiplied by the distance between the reference datum and the aircraft's center of gravity, in Newton-meters.

fuelWeight.description: The weight of usable fuel on board the aircraft, in kilograms.

fuelMoment.description: The fuel weight on board the aircraft multiplied by the distance between the reference datum and the fuel's center of gravity, in Newton-meters.

estLandingFuelWeight.description: The estimated weight of usable fuel upon landing, in kilograms.

estLandingFuelMoment.description: The estimated weight of usable fuel upon landing multiplied by the distance between the reference datum and the fuel's center of gravity, in Newton-meters.

operatingWeight.description: The basic weight of the aircraft including passengers and equipment, in kilograms.

operatingMoment.description: The operating weight of the aircraft multiplied by the distance between the reference datum and the aircraft's center of gravity, in Newton-meters.

cargoWeight.description: The weight of the cargo on board the aircraft, in kilograms.

cargoMoment.description: The sum of cargo moments of all cargo on board the aircraft, in Newton-meters. Each individual cargo moment is the weight of the cargo multiplied by the distance between the reference datum and the cargo's center of gravity.

zeroFuelWeight.description: The operating weight of the aircraft including cargo, mail, baggage, and passengers, but without usable fuel, in kilograms.

zeroFuelMoment.description: The zero fuel weight of the aircraft multiplied by the distance between the reference datum and the aircraft's center of gravity, in Newton-meters.

zeroFuelCG.description: The center of gravity of the aircraft using the zero fuel weight and zero fuel total moment, as a percentage of the mean aerodynamic chord (%MAC).

grossWeight.description: The total weight of the aircraft at takeoff including passengers, cargo, equipment, and usable fuel, in kilograms.

grossMoment.description: The sum of moments of all items making up the gross weight of the aircraft, in Newton-meters.

grossCG.description: The center of gravity of the aircraft using the gross weight and gross moment, as a percentage of the mean aerodynamic chord (%MAC).

landingWeight.description: The gross weight of the aircraft upon landing, in kilograms.

landingMoment.description: The sum of moments of all items making up the gross weight of the aircraft upon landing, in Newton-meters.

landingCG.description: The center of gravity of the aircraft using the landing weight and landing moment, as a percentage of the mean aerodynamic chord (%MAC).

seatsOnboard.description: Number of passenger seats on the aircraft.

seatsReleased.description: Number of passenger seats released this leg.

ppOnboard.description: Number of pallet positions on the aircraft.

ppReleased.description: Number of pallet positions released this leg.

aclOnboard.description: Allowable Cabin Load (ACL) onboard the aircraft. The maximum weight of passengers, baggage, and cargo that can be safely transported in the aircraft cabin, in kilograms.

aclReleased.description: Allowable Cabin Load (ACL) released this leg. The weight of passengers, baggage, and cargo released from the aircraft cabin, in kilograms.

cargoBayFSMin.description: Minimum fuselage station (FS) where cargo can be stored. FS is the distance from the reference datum, in meters.

cargoBayFSMax.description: Maximum fuselage station (FS) where cargo can be stored. FS is the distance from the reference datum, in meters.

cargoBayWidth.description: Width of the cargo bay, in meters.

cargoVolume.description: Volume of cargo space in the aircraft, in cubic meters.

loadmasterName.description: Name of the loadmaster or boom operator who received the cargo briefing.

loadmasterRank.description: Rank of the loadmaster or boom operator overseeing cargo loading/unloading.

availableTime.description: Time the loadmaster or boom operator is available for cargo loading/unloading, in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

schedTime.description: Time the loadmaster or boom operator is scheduled to begin overseeing cargo loading/unloading, in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

briefTime.description: Time the cargo briefing was given to the loadmaster or boom operator, in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

utilCode.description: Alphanumeric code that describes general cargo-related utilization and characteristics for an itinerary point.

airLoadPlanULNActuals.description: Collection of unit line number actuals associated with this load plan.

airLoadPlanHazmatActuals.description: Collection of hazmat actuals associated with this load plan.

airLoadPlanPaxCargo.description: Collection of passenger and cargo details associated with this load plan for this leg of the mission.

airLoadPlanPalletDetails.description: Collection of cargo information located at the pallet positions associated with this load plan.

airLoadPlanHR.description: Collection of human remains transport information associated with this load plan.

numCOG.description: The number of aircraft that are currently on ground (COG) at the airfield.

wideWorkingMOG.description: Maximum on ground (MOG) number of working wide-body aircraft based on spacing and manpower at the time of status. Additional information about this field as it pertains to specific aircraft type may be available in an associated SiteOperations record.

wideParkingMOG.description: Maximum on ground (MOG) number of parking wide-body aircraft based on spacing and manpower at the time of status. Additional information about this field as it pertains to specific aircraft type may be available in an associated SiteOperations record.

narrowWorkingMOG.description: Maximum on ground (MOG) number of working narrow-body aircraft based on spacing and manpower at the time of status.

narrowParkingMOG.description: Maximum on ground (MOG) number of parking narrow-body aircraft based on spacing and manpower at the time of status.

mheTypes.description: Array of material handling equipment types at the airfield. This array must be the same length as mheQtys.

mheQtys.description: Array of quantities for each material handling equipment types at the airfield. The values in this array must correspond to the position index in mheTypes. This array must be the same length as mheTypes.

medCap.description: The level of medical support and capabilities available at the airfield.

arffCat.description: The category of aircraft rescue and fire fighting (ARFF) services that are currently available at the airfield. Entries should include  the code (FAA or ICAO) and the category.

gseTime.description: The expected time to receive ground support equipment (e.g. power units, air units, cables, hoses, etc.), in minutes.

priRwyNum.description: The number or ID of primary runway at the airfield.

rwyCondReading.description: The primary runway condition reading value used for determining runway braking action, from 0 to 26. A value of 0 indicates braking action is poor or non-existent, where a value of 26 indicates braking action is good.

rwyFrictionFactor.description: The primary runway friction factor which is dependent on the surface friction between the tires of the aircraft and the runway surface, from 0 to 100. A lower number indicates less friction and less braking response.

rwyMarkings.description: Array of markings currently on the primary runway.

message.description: Description of the current status of the airfield.

priFreq.description: The primary frequency which the airfield is currently operating, in megahertz.

slotTypesReq.description: Array of slot types that an airfield requires a particular aircraft provide in order to consume a slot at this location.

cmStatId.description: Airspace control means name or designator. Mandatory if acmStat equals "DELETE," otherwise this field is prohibited.

cmStat.description: Status of Airspace Control Means. Must be ADD, CHANGE, or DELETE.

cmStatId.description: Airspace control means name or designator. Mandatory if acmStat equals "DELETE," otherwise this field is prohibited.

airspaceControlMeans.description: A conditional nested segment to report multiple airspace control means within a particular airspace control means status.

AirspaceControlMeans_Abridged.description: A conditional nested segment to report multiple airspace control means within a particular airspace control means status.

cmType.description: The code for the type of airspace control means.

cmId.description: Airspace control means name or designator.

cmShape.description: Designates the geometric type that defines the airspace shape. One of CIRCLE, CORRIDOR, LINE, ORBIT, etc.

usage.description: Designates the means by which a defined airspace control means is to be used.

link16Id.description: Unique Link 16 identifier assigned to the airspace control means.

transAltitude.description: The altitude at or below which the vertical position of an aircraft is controlled by reference to true altitude.

geoDatumAlt.description: Specifies the geodetic datum by which the spatial coordinates of the controlled airspace are calculated, if different from the top level ACO datum.

coord0.description: A geospatial point coordinate specified in DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) format. The fields coord0 and coord1 should be used in the specification of any airspace control shape that requires exactly one (1) or two (2) reference points for construction. For shapes requiring one reference point, for instance, when cmShape is set to "APOINT", this field is required and singularly defines the shape. Similarly, this field is required to define the center point of a "CIRCLE" shape, or the "origin of bearing" for arcs.

coord1.description: A geospatial point coordinate specified in DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) format. The fields coord0 and coord1 should be used in the specification of any airspace control shape that requires exactly one (1) or two (2) reference points for construction. For shapes requiring one reference point, for instance, when cmShape is set to "APOINT", this field is required and singularly defines the shape. Similarly, this field is required to define the center point of a "CIRCLE" shape, or the "origin of bearing" for arcs.

bearing0.description: A bearing measured from true North, in angular degrees. If cmShape is set to "POLYARC" or "RADARC", this field is required and is mapped to the "beginning" radial bearing parameter.

bearing1.description: A bearing measured from true North, in angular degrees. If cmShape is set to "POLYARC" or "RADARC", this field is required and is mapped to the "ending" radial bearing parameter.

radMag0.description: A distance that represents a radial magnitude. If cmShape is set to "CIRCLE" or "POLYARC", one of either fields radMag0 or radMag1 is required. If cmShape is set to "RADARC", this field is required and maps to the "inner" radial magnitude arc limit. If provided, the field radMagUnit is required.

radMag1.description: A distance that represents a radial magnitude. If cmShape is set to "CIRCLE" or "POLYARC", one of either fields radMag0 or radMag1 is required. If cmShape is set to "RADARC", this field is required and maps to the "outer" radial magnitude arc limit. If provided, the field radMagUnit is required.

radMagUnit.description: Specifies the unit of length in which radial magnitudes are given. Use M for meters, KM for kilometers, or NM for nautical miles.

polyCoord.description: A set of geospatial coordinates specified in DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) format which determine the vertices of a one or two dimensional geospatial shape. When cmShape is set to "POLYARC" or "POLYGON", this field is required as applied in the construction of the area boundary. If cmShape is set to "CORRIDOR" or "GEOLINE", this field is required and can be interpreted as an ordered set of points along a path in space.

trackLeg.description: Index of a segment in an airtrack, which is defined by an ordered set of points.

widthLeft.description: Given an ordered pair of spatial coordinates (p0, p1), defines a distance extending into the LEFT half-plane relative to the direction of the vector that maps p0 to p1. If cmShape is set to "1TRACK", this field is required to define the width of the airspace track as measured from the left of the track segment line. If provided, the field widthUnit is required.

widthRight.description: Given an ordered pair of spatial coordinates (p0, p1), defines a distance extending into the RIGHT half-plane relative to the direction of the vector that maps p0 to p1. If cmShape is set to "1TRACK", this field is required to define the width of the airspace track as measured from the right of the track segment line. If provided, the field widthUnit is required.

width.description: Used to describe the "side to side" distance of a target, object or area. If cmShape is set to "CORRIDOR" or "AORBIT", this field is required and is mapped to the width parameter. If provided, the field widthUnit is required.

widthUnit.description: Specifies the unit of length for which widths are given. Use M for meters, KM for kilometers, or NM for nautical miles.

corrWayPoints.description: An array of at least two alphanumeric symbols used to serially identify the corridor waypoints. If cmShape is set to "CORRIDOR", one of either corrWayPoints or polyCoord is required to specify the centerline of the corridor path.

orbitAlignment.description: Orbit alignment look-up code. Can be C=Center, L=Left, R=Right.

effVDim.description: Description of the airspace vertical dimension.

airspaceTimePeriod.description: The timePeriods set describes the effective datetime for a given airspace control means.

airspaceControlPoint.description: The controlPoint set describes any reference/controlling/rendezvous point for a given airspace control means.

cntrlAuth.description: The commander responsible within a specified geographical area for the airspace control operation assigned to him.

cntrlAuthFreqs.description: The frequency for the airspace control authority. Can specify HZ, KHZ, MHZ, GHZ or a DESIG frequency designator code.

genTextInd.description: Used to provide transit instructions for the airspace control means.

freeText.description: General informat detailing the transit instruction for the airspace control means.
freeText.example: 1. CAPACITY: MDM TK, 50 VEHICLE CONVOY. 2. CHOKE POINTS: EXIT 5

width.description: Used to describe the "side to side" distance of a target, object or area. If cmShape is set to "CORRIDOR" or "AORBIT", this field is required and is mapped to the width parameter. If provided, the field widthUnit is required.

widthUnit.description: Specifies the unit of length for which widths are given. Use M for meters, KM for kilometers, or NM for nautical miles.

cmId.description: Airspace control means name or designator.

cmShape.description: Designates the geometric type that defines the airspace shape. One of CIRCLE, CORRIDOR, LINE, ORBIT, etc.

usage.description: Designates the means by which a defined airspace control means is to be used.

link16Id.description: Unique Link 16 identifier assigned to the airspace control means.

transAltitude.description: The altitude at or below which the vertical position of an aircraft is controlled by reference to true altitude.

geoDatumAlt.description: Specifies the geodetic datum by which the spatial coordinates of the controlled airspace are calculated, if different from the top level ACO datum.

coord0.description: A geospatial point coordinate specified in DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) format. The fields coord0 and coord1 should be used in the specification of any airspace control shape that requires exactly one (1) or two (2) reference points for construction. For shapes requiring one reference point, for instance, when cmShape is set to "APOINT", this field is required and singularly defines the shape. Similarly, this field is required to define the center point of a "CIRCLE" shape, or the "origin of bearing" for arcs.

coord1.description: A geospatial point coordinate specified in DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) format. The fields coord0 and coord1 should be used in the specification of any airspace control shape that requires exactly one (1) or two (2) reference points for construction. For shapes requiring one reference point, for instance, when cmShape is set to "APOINT", this field is required and singularly defines the shape. Similarly, this field is required to define the center point of a "CIRCLE" shape, or the "origin of bearing" for arcs.

bearing0.description: A bearing measured from true North, in angular degrees. If cmShape is set to "POLYARC" or "RADARC", this field is required and is mapped to the "beginning" radial bearing parameter.

bearing1.description: A bearing measured from true North, in angular degrees. If cmShape is set to "POLYARC" or "RADARC", this field is required and is mapped to the "ending" radial bearing parameter.

radMag0.description: A distance that represents a radial magnitude. If cmShape is set to "CIRCLE" or "POLYARC", one of either fields radMag0 or radMag1 is required. If cmShape is set to "RADARC", this field is required and maps to the "inner" radial magnitude arc limit. If provided, the field radMagUnit is required.

radMag1.description: A distance that represents a radial magnitude. If cmShape is set to "CIRCLE" or "POLYARC", one of either fields radMag0 or radMag1 is required. If cmShape is set to "RADARC", this field is required and maps to the "outer" radial magnitude arc limit. If provided, the field radMagUnit is required.

radMagUnit.description: Specifies the unit of length in which radial magnitudes are given. Use M for meters, KM for kilometers, or NM for nautical miles.

polyCoord.description: A set of geospatial coordinates specified in DMS (Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) format which determine the vertices of a one or two dimensional geospatial shape. When cmShape is set to "POLYARC" or "POLYGON", this field is required as applied in the construction of the area boundary. If cmShape is set to "CORRIDOR" or "GEOLINE", this field is required and can be interpreted as an ordered set of points along a path in space.

trackLeg.description: Index of a segment in an airtrack, which is defined by an ordered set of points.

widthLeft.description: Given an ordered pair of spatial coordinates (p0, p1), defines a distance extending into the LEFT half-plane relative to the direction of the vector that maps p0 to p1. widthRight.description: Given an ordered pair of spatial coordinates (p0, p1), defines a distance extending into the RIGHT half-plane relative to the direction of the vector that maps p0 to p1. AnalyticImagery_Abridged.description: The analytic imagery schema supports data plots and graphics of various types. The records contain general file information, allows for annotations to user-defined areas of interest on the graphics, and supports keyword searching.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

content.description: General type of content of this image (CONTOUR, DIAGRAM, HEATMAP, HISTOGRAM, PLOT, SCREENSHOT).

msgTime.description: The message time of this image record, in ISO8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

imageType.description: The type of image associated with this record (GIF, JPG, PNG, TIF).

idSensor.description: Unique identifier of the reporting sensor.

origSensorId.description: Optional identifier provided by the source to indicate the sensor for this collection. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily a valid sensor ID.

filename.description: The image file name.

filesize.description: The image file size, in bytes.  The maximum file size for this service is 40,000,000 bytes (40MB). Files exceeding the maximum size will be rejected.

xUnits.description: Optional field indicating the units that apply to the x-axis of the attached image, when applicable.

yUnits.description: Optional field indicating the units that apply to the y-axis of the attached image, when applicable.

zUnits.description: Optional field indicating the units that apply to the z-axis of the attached image, when applicable.

imageSetId.description: User-defined set ID of a sequence of images.  Used to associate related analytic image records.

imageSetLength.description: The number of images in an image set.

sequenceId.description: The sequence number of an image within an image set.  If null, then it is assumed that the order of images in an imageSet is not relevant.

description.description: Description of the image content and utility.

dataStart.description: The start time, in ISO8601 UTC format with millisecond precision, of the data used in the analysis or composition of the image content, when applicable.

dataStop.description: The stop time, in ISO8601 UTC format with millisecond precision, of the data used in the analysis or composition of the image content, when applicable.

annLims.description: Rectangular annotation limits, specified in pixels, as an array of arrays of the coordinates [ [UL1x, UL1y], [UR1x, UR1y], [LR1x, LR1y], [LL1x, LL1y] ], indicating the corners of a rectangle beginning with the Upper Left (UL) and moving clockwise. Allows the image provider to highlight one or more rectangular area(s) of interest. The array must contain Nx4 two-element arrays, where N is the number of rectangles of interest.  The associated annotation(s) should be included in the annText array.

annText.description: Annotation text, a string array of annotation(s) corresponding to the rectangular areas specified in annLims.  This array contains the annotation text associated with the areas of interest indicated in annLims, in order.  This array should contain one annotation per four values of the area (annLims) array.

keywords.description: Array of searchable keywords for this analytic imagery record.

atext.description: Geographical region or polygon (lon/lat pairs), as depicted by the Well-Known Text representation of the geometry/geography, of the image as projected on the ground. WKT reference: https://www.opengeospatial.org/standards/wkt-crs. Ignored if included with a POST or PUT request that also specifies a valid 'area' field.

agjson.description: Geographical region or polygon (lat/lon pairs), as depicted by the GeoJSON representation of the geometry/geography, of the image as projected on the ground. GeoJSON Reference: https://geojson.org/. Ignored if included with a POST or PUT request that also specifies a valid 'area' or 'atext' field.

atype.description: Type of region as projected on the ground.

andims.description: Number of dimensions of the geometry depicted by region.

satId.description: Assessed satellite ID (NORAD RSO object number).  The 'satId' and 'satIdConf' arrays must match in size.

satIdConf.description: Assessed satellite confidence corresponding to an assessment ID.  Values are between 0.0 and 1.0.  The 'satId' and 'satIdConf' arrays must match in size.

srcTyps.description: Array of UDL record types (AIS, CONJUNCTION, DOA, ELSET, EO, ESID, GROUNDIMAGE, POI, MANEUVER, MTI, NOTIFICATION, RADAR, RF, SIGACT, SKYIMAGE, SV, TRACK) that are related to this image. See the associated 'srcIds' array for the record UUIDs, positionally corresponding to the record types in this array. The 'srcTyps' and 'srcIds' arrays must match in size.

annLims.description: Rectangular annotation limits, specified in pixels, as an array of arrays of the coordinates [ [UL1x, UL1y], [UR1x, UR1y], [LR1x, LR1y], [LL1x, LL1y] ], indicating the corners of a rectangle beginning with the Upper Left (UL) and moving clockwise. Allows the image provider to highlight one or more rectangular area(s) of interest. The array must contain Nx4 two-element arrays, where N is the number of rectangles of interest.  The associated annotation(s) should be included in the annText array.

annText.description: Annotation text, a string array of annotation(s) corresponding to the rectangular areas specified in annLims.  This array contains the annotation text associated with the areas of interest indicated in annLims, in order.  This array should contain one annotation per four values of the area (annLims) array.

keywords.description: Array of searchable keywords for this analytic imagery record.

area.description: Optional geographical region or polygon (lat/lon pairs) of the area surrounding the point of interest as projected on the ground.

atext.description: Geographical region or polygon (lon/lat pairs), as depicted by the Well-Known Text representation of the geometry/geography, of the image as projected on the ground. agjson.description: Geographical region or polygon (lat/lon pairs), as depicted by the GeoJSON representation of the geometry/geography, of the image as projected on the ground. atype.description: Type of region as projected on the ground.

andims.description: Number of dimensions of the geometry depicted by region.

satIdConf.description: Assessed satellite confidence corresponding to an assessment ID.  Values are between 0.0 and 1.0.  The 'satId' and 'satIdConf' arrays must match in size.

AttitudeData_Abridged.description: These services provide operations for posting and querying attitude of on-orbit objects.  Attitude describes the orientation of an object, which can be represented by quaternions or euler angles.  The AttitudeSet ID (asId) identifies the 'AttitudeSet' record which contains details of the underlying data as well as a collection of attitude points. Points must be retrieved by first identifying a desired AttitudeSet and pulling its points by that AttitudeSet ID 'asId'.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

asId.description: Unique identifier of the parent AttitudeSet associated with this record.

idOnOrbit.description: Unique identifier of the on-orbit satellite to which this attitude record applies.

satNo.description: Satellite/catalog number of the on-orbit object to which this attitude record applies.

origObjectId.description: Optional identifier provided by the record source to indicate the target object of this attitude record. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily map to a valid satellite number.

ts.description: Time associated with this attitude record, in ISO 8601 UTC format, with microsecond precision.

motionType.description: Label specifying type of rotational motion of target.

xAngle.description: Array of X body rotation Euler angle(s), in degrees (-180 to 180).  For repeated axis rotations, the array elements should be placed in the order that the angles apply in the sequence.

yAngle.description: Array of Y body rotation Euler angle(s), in degrees (-180 to 180).  For repeated axis rotations, the array elements should be placed in the order that the angles apply in the sequence.

zAngle.description: Array of Z body rotation Euler angle(s), in degrees (-180 to 180).  For repeated axis rotations, the array elements should be placed in the order that the angles apply in the sequence.

xRate.description: Array of X body rotation rate(s), in degrees per second.  For repeated axis rotations, the array elements should be placed in the order that the rates apply in the sequence.  Attitude rates are expressed in frame1 with respect to frame2.

yRate.description: Array of Y body rotation rate(s), in degrees per second.  For repeated axis rotations, the array elements should be placed in the order that the rates apply in the sequence.  Attitude rates are expressed in frame1 with respect to frame2.

zRate.description: Array of Z body rotation rate(s), in degrees per second.  For repeated axis rotations, the array elements should be placed in the order that the rates apply in the sequence  Attitude rates are expressed in frame1 with respect to frame2.

ra.description: Precession axis right ascension (ECI J2000 frame) in degrees.

declination.description: Precession axis declination (ECI J2000 frame) in degrees.

AttitudeData_Ingest.description: These services provide operations for posting and querying attitude of on-orbit objects.  Attitude describes the orientation of an object, which can be represented by quaternions or euler angles.  The AttitudeSet ID (asId) identifies the 'AttitudeSet' record which contains details of the underlying data as well as a collection of attitude points. Points must be retrieved by first identifying a desired AttitudeSet and pulling its points by that AttitudeSet ID 'asId'.

AttitudeSet_Abridged.description: AttitudeSet represents a wrapper or collection of Onorbit Attitude 'points' and meta data indicating the specifics of the orientation of an on-orbit object.  Attitude is typically distributed in a flat file containing details of the attitude generation as well as a large collection of individual points at varying time steps. AttitudeSet is analogous to this flat file.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

idOnOrbit.description: Unique identifier of the on-orbit satellite to which this attitude set applies.

satNo.description: Satellite/catalog number of the on-orbit object to which this attitude set applies.

origObjectId.description: Optional identifier provided by the record source to indicate the target object of this attitude set. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily map to a valid satellite number.

type.description:
The type of attitude message or messages associated with this set.

AEM = Attitude Ephemeris Message, specifying the attitude state of a single object at multiple epochs.

APM = Attitude Parameters Message, specifying the attitude state of a single object at a single epoch.

esId.description: Unique identifier of the parent (positional) Ephemeris Set, if this data is correlated with an Ephemeris.

idSensor.description: Unique identifier of the sensor to which this attitude set applies IF this set is reporting a single sensor orientation.

origSensorId.description: Optional identifier provided by the record source to indicate the sensor identifier to which this attitude set applies IF this set is reporting a single sensor orientation. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily a valid sensor ID.

startTime.description: The epoch or start time of the attitude parameter or attitude ephemeris, in ISO 8601 UTC format, with microsecond precision.  If this set is constituted by a single attitude parameter message then startTime is the epoch.

endTime.description: The end time of the attitude ephemeris, in ISO 8601 UTC format, with microsecond precision.  If this set is constituted by a single epoch attitude message then endTime should match the startTime.

frame1.description: Reference frame 1 of the quaternion or Euler angle transformation utilized in this attitude parameter or attitude ephemeris.  The UDL convention is that transformations occur FROM frame1 TO frame2.  A specific spacecraft frame or instrument name may be provided with the assumption the consumer understands the location of these frames (ex. SC BODY, J2000, LVLH, ICRF, INSTRUMENTx, THRUSTERx, etc.).

frame2.description: Reference frame 2 of the quaternion or Euler angle transformation utilized in this attitude parameter or attitude ephemeris.  The UDL convention is that transformations occur FROM frame1 TO frame2.  A specific spacecraft frame or instrument name may be provided with the assumption the consumer understands the location of these frames (ex. SC BODY, J2000, LVLH, ICRF, INSTRUMENTx, THRUSTERx, etc.).

numPoints.description: Number of attitude records contained in this set.

stepSize.description: Attitude ephemeris step size, in seconds. This applies to Attitude Ephemeris Messages (AEM) that employ a fixed step size.

precAngleInit.description: Initial precession angle (ECI J2000 frame) in degrees.

spinAngleInit.description: Initial spin angle (ECI J2000 frame) in degrees.

eulerRotSeq.description:
The rotation sequence of the Euler angles in which attitude reference frame transformation occurs (from left to right). One, two, or three axis rotations are supported and are represented by one, two, or three characters respectively.  Repeated axis rotations are also supported, however, these rotations should not be sequential.  The numeric sequence values correspond to the body angles/rates as follows: 1 - xAngle/xRate, 2 - yAngle/yRate, and 3 - zAngle/zRate.  Valid sequences are: 123, 132, 213, 231, 312, 321, 121, 131, 212, 232, 313, 323, 12, 13, 21, 23, 31, 32, 1, 2, and 3. 



The following represent examples of possible rotation sequences:  A single rotation about the Y-axis can be expressed as '2', a double rotation with X-Z sequence can be expressed as '13', and a triple rotation with Z-X-Y sequence can be expressed as '312'.

BeamContour_Abridged.description: Describes the beam contour associated with a beam entity. Beam contours are the geographic representation of the relative gain levels of beam power off of the maximum gain boresight points.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

type.description: The type of object represented in this record (BORESIGHT, CONTOUR, SVC AREA).  Boresight refers to the point of maximum/peak gain, and should not be confused with the 'aim point' of the related beam.  Gain contours are regions of  coverage referenced to the relative gain of the related beam.  Service Areas are composed of one or more service regions, with each region being either discrete point(s) or a continuous contour.

contourIdx.description: The index number of this contour. The value is required if type = CONTOUR.

gain.description: The relative gain level in dB associated with this boresight or contour.  Gain does not apply to service area records. The value is required if type = BORESIGHT or CONTOUR.

regionName.description: The region name within the service area.

geographyText.description: Geographical region or polygon (lon/lat pairs), as depicted by the Well-Known Text representation of the geometry/geography, of the image as projected on the ground. WKT reference: https://www.opengeospatial.org/standards/wkt-crs. Ignored if included with a POST or PUT request that also specifies a valid 'area' field.

geographyJson.description: Geographical region or polygon (lat/lon pairs), as depicted by the GeoJSON representation of the geometry/geography, of the image as projected on the ground. GeoJSON Reference: https://geojson.org/. Ignored if included with a POST or PUT request that also specifies a valid 'area' or 'atext' field.

geographyNdims.description: Number of dimensions of the geometry depicted by region.

idOnOrbit1.description: Unique identifier of the primary satellite on-orbit object, if correlated. For rendezvous and proximity operations, this is the target on-orbit object. When the secondary object is on the rendezvous capable list, this can be any object.

satNo1.description: Satellite/catalog number of the target on-orbit primary object.

origObjectId1.description: Optional place holder for an OnOrbit ID that does not exist in UDL.

idOnOrbit2.description: Unique identifier of the secondary satellite on-orbit object, if correlated. For rendezvous and proximity operations, this is the actor. When the primary object is a satellite being protected on the neighborhood watch list (NWL), this can be any object encroaching on the primary.

satNo2.description: Satellite/catalog number of the target on-orbit secondary object.

origObjectId2.description: Optional place holder for an OnOrbit ID that does not exist in UDL.

eventType.description: The type of event associated with this record. Values include: DOCK, UNDOCK, SEPARATION, RENDEZVOUS, PROXIMITY, PEZ, WEZ.

eventStartTime.description: Timestamp representing the events start time in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

eventEndTime.description: Timestamp representing the events end time in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

actorSVEpoch.description: State vector epoch time of the actor satellite in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

targetSVEpoch.description: State vector epoch time of the target satellite in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

idActorSV.description: Optional ID of the UDL State Vector at epoch time of the actor satellite. When performing a create, this id will be ignored in favor of the UDL generated id of the actor state vector.

idTargetSV.description: Optional ID of the UDL State Vector at epoch time of the target satellite. When performing a create, this id will be ignored in favor of the UDL generated id of the target state vector.

analysisEpoch.description: Epoch time of the beginning of the analysis period in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

analysisDuration.description: Timespan of the rendezvous analysis in seconds.

durationThreshold.description: The threshold of the event duration in seconds.

rangeThreshold.description: The threshold of the event range in kilometers.

eventIntervalCoverage.description: Percentage of the event interval that is within the plane tolerance specified as a percent value between 0 and 100.

numSubIntervals.description: The number of oscillations within the event interval which are within the plane tolerance.

minRange.description: Minimum range (apogee and perigee differences) within the event interval measured in kilometers.

minRangeEpoch.description: Epoch time of the minimum range occurrence in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

minRangeAnalysisDuration.description: Timespan of satellites within the range tolerance in seconds.

minPlaneSepAngle.description: Minimum angle between the target's position and the projection of the actor's position into the target's nominal orbit plane over the event interval measured in degrees.

minPlaneSepEpoch.description: Epoch time of the minimum in-plane separation angle occurrence in ISO 8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

orbitAlignDel.description: The change in angle between the angular momentum vectors between the actor and target relative to plane orientation in degrees.

maxRange.description: Maximum range (apogee and perigee differences) within the event interval measured in kilometers.

csoDetails.description: A collection of orbital metrics for the event at the start and end times, and the mean values of the primary and secondary objects, as well as the deltas between the primary and secondary objects.

hohmannDeltaV.description: The Hohmann DeltaV (kilometers per second) is the minimum delta velocity for the in-plane orbit change. The in-plane maneuvers change the semi-major axis (perigee and/or apogee). It is the minimum assuming two maneuvers; a lower delta velocity is possible with bi-elliptic transfers involving three maneuvers.

inclinationDeltaV.description: The Inclination DeltaV is the minimum delta velocity for the out-of-plane change, assuming alignment of the right ascensions measured in kilometers per second.

totalDeltaV.description: The Total DeltaV is the sum of the Hohmann and Inclination DeltaVs measured in kilometers per second.

orbitPlaneTol.description: The tolerance value for the difference in the orbital plane measured in degrees.

rangeTol.description: The tolerance value for the range in kilometers.

deltaVTol.description: The tolerance value for the DeltaV, in kilometers per second.

lonTol.description: The tolerance value for the longitude in degrees.

stationLimLonTol.description: The tolerance value for the optimal longitude for station-keeping in degrees.

relPosMag.description: Range of closest approach: relative position magnitude, in kilometers, of the difference in the physical position between the actor and target objects.

relSpeedMag.description: Indicates the closure rate specified as a relative velocity magnitude in kilometers per second of the difference in the velocities between the actor and target objects.

relPos.description: Indicates the relative position vector of the event occurrence measured in kilometers.

relVel.description: Indicates the relative velocity vector of the event occurrence measured in kilometers per second.

indicationSource.description: Identifies the source of the indication, if the latest event info was manually input, not computed.

notes.description: Contains other descriptive information associated with an indicated event.

createdAt.description: Time the row was created in the database, auto-populated by the system.

createdBy.description: Application user who created the row in the database, auto-populated by the system.

sourceDL.description: The source data library from which this record was received. This could be a remote or tactical UDL or another data library. If null, the record should be assumed to have originated from the primary Enterprise UDL.

origin.description: Originating system or organization which produced the data, if different from the source. The origin may be different than the source if the source was a mediating system which forwarded the data on behalf of the origin system. If null, the source may be assumed to be the origin.

origNetwork.description: The originating source network on which this record was created, auto-populated by the system.

CollectRequest_Abridged.description: Collect Requests support several types of individual requests, or planned/scheduled tasks on sensors and/or orbital objects. Options are provided to accomodate most common sensor contact and collection applications, including single sensor-object tasking, search operations, and TT&C support. Multiple requests originating from a plan or schedule may be associated to a sensor plan if desired.

id.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

idParentReq.description: The unique ID of the collect request record from which this request originated. This may be used for cases of sensor-to-sensor tasking, such as tip/cue operations.

msgType.description: The type of external message from which this request originated.

msgCreateDate.description: The timestamp of the external message from which this request originated, if applicable, in ISO8601 UTC format with millisecond precision.

type.description: The type of this collect or contact request (DIRECTED SEARCH, DWELL, OBJECT, POL, RATE TRACK, SEARCH, SOI, STARE, TTC, VOLUME SEARCH, etc.).

idPlan.description: Unique identifier of the parent plan or schedule associated with this request.  If null, this request is assumed not associated with a plan or schedule.

planIndex.description: Index number (integer) for records within a collection plan or schedule.

taskId.description: Task ID associated with this request.  A task ID may be associated with a single collect request or may be used to tie together the sub-requests of a full collect, for example a DWELL consisting of many dwell points.

dwellId.description: The dwell ID associated with this request.  A dwell ID is dwell point specific and a DWELL request consist of many dwell point requests.

externalId.description: Optional ID from external systems.  This field has no meaning within UDL and is provided as a convenience for systems that require tracking of an internal system generated ID.

idSensor.description: Unique identifier of the requested/scheduled/planned sensor associated with this request.  If both idSensor and origSensorId are null then the request is assumed to be a general request for observations or contact on an object, if specified, or an area/volume.  In this case, the requester may specify a desired obType.

origSensorId.description: Optional identifier provided by the source to indicate the sensor identifier requested/scheduled/planned for this request. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily a valid sensor ID.  If both idSensor and origSensorId are null then the request is assumed to be a general request for observations or contact on an object, if specified, or an area/volume.  In this case, the requester may specify a desired obType.

obType.description: Optional type of observation (EO, IR, RADAR, RF-ACTIVE, RF-PASSIVE, OTHER) requested.  This field may correspond to a request of a specific sensor, or to a general non sensor specific request.

priority.description: The priority of the collect request  (EMERGENCY, FLASH, IMMEDIATE, PRIORITY, ROUTINE).

taskCategory.description: The (SSN) tasking category (1-5) associated with this request.  The tasking category defines the priority of gathering and transmitting the requested observational data.  Note that category definitions are sensor type specific.

suffix.description: The (SSN) tasking suffix (A-Z) associated with this request.  The suffix defines the amount of observational data and the frequency of collection.  Note that suffix definitions are sensor type specific.

uctFollowUp.description: Boolean indicating that this collect request is UCT follow-up.

startTime.description: The start time or earliest time of the collect or contact request window, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

endTime.description: The end time of the collect or contact request window, in ISO 8601 UTC format.  If no endTime or duration is provided it is assumed the request is either ongoing or that the request is for a specified number of tracks (numTracks).  If both duration and endTime are provided, the endTime is assumed to take precedence.

idOnOrbit.description: Unique identifier of the target on-orbit object for this request.

satNo.description: Satellite/catalog number of the target on-orbit object for this request.

origObjectId.description: Optional identifier provided by the data source to indicate the target object of this request. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily map to a valid satellite number.

taskGroup.description: The tasking group to which the target object is assigned.

iron.description: Inter-Range Operations Number.  Four-digit identifier used to schedule and identify AFSCN contact support for booster, launch, and on-orbit operations.

orbitRegime.description: The orbit regime of the target (GEO, HEO, LAUNCH, LEO, MEO, OTHER).

targetSize.description: The minimum object (diameter) size, in meters, to be reported.

rcsMin.description: The minimum Radar Cross-Section of the target, in m^2.  If only minimum RCS is provided it is assumed to be minimum reportable RCS.

rcs.description: The Radar Cross-Section of the target, in m^2.

rcsMax.description: The maximum Radar Cross-Section of the target, in m^2.

freqMin.description: The minimum frequency of interest, in MHz.  If only minimum frequency is provided it is assumed to be minimum reportable frequency.

freq.description: The estimated or expected emission frequency of the target, in MHz.

freqMax.description: The maximum frequency of interest, in MHz.

polarization.description: The RF polarization (H, LHC, RHC, V).

visMagMin.description: The minimum estimated or expected visual magnitude of the target, in Magnitudes (M).  If only minimum vismag is provided it is assumed to be minimum reportable vismag.

visMag.description: The estimated or expected visual magnitude of the target, in Magnitudes (M).

visMagMax.description: The maximum estimated or expected visual magnitude of the target, in Magnitudes (M).

spectralModel.description: The spectral model used for the irradiance calculation.

reflectance.description: The fraction of solar energy reflected from target.

numFrames.description: For optical sensors, the requested number of frames to capture at each sensor step.

frameRate.description: For optical sensors, the frame rate of the camera, in Hz.

integrationTime.description: For optical sensors, the integration time per camera frame, in milliseconds.

numTracks.description: The number of requested tracks on the target.  If numTracks is not provided it is assumed to indicate all possible observations every pass over the request duration or within the request start/end window.

numObs.description: The number of requested observations on the target.

duration.description: The duration of the collect request, in seconds.  If both duration and endTime are provided, the endTime is assumed to take precedence.

srchPattern.description: The search pattern to be executed for this request (e.g. PICKET-FENCE, SCAN, etc.).

scenario.description: Pre-coordinated code, direction, or configuration to be executed by the sensor or site for this collect or contact.

idElset.description: ID of the UDL Elset of the object associated with this request.

idManifold.description: ID of the UDL Manifold Elset of the object associated with this request.  A Manifold Elset provides theoretical Keplerian orbital elements belonging to an object of interest's manifold describing a possible/theoretical orbit for an object of interest for tasking purposes.

idStateVector.description: ID of the UDL State Vector of the object or central vector associated with this request.

esId.description: ID of the UDL Ephemeris Set of the object associated with this request.

epoch.description: Epoch time, in ISO 8601 UTC format, of the orbital elements.

semiMajorAxis.description: The average of the periapsis and apoapsis distances, in kilometers. For circular orbits, the semimajor axis is the distance between the centers of the bodies.

eccentricity.description: The orbital eccentricity of an astronomical object is a parameter that determines the amount by which its orbit around another body deviates from a perfect circle.

inclination.description: The angle, in degrees, between the equator and the orbit plane when looking from the center of the Earth. Inclination ranges from 0-180 degrees, with 0-90 representing posigrade orbits and 90-180 representing retrograde orbits.

raan.description: Right ascension of the ascending node, or RAAN is the angle as measured in degrees eastwards (or, as seen from the north, counterclockwise) from the First Point of Aries to the ascending node.

argOfPerigee.description: The argument of perigee is the angle, in degrees, formed between the perigee and the ascending node.

trueAnomoly.description: The true anomaly defines the angular position, in degrees, of the object on it's orbital path as measured from the orbit focal point at epoch.  The true anomaly is referenced from perigee.

ra.description: The expected or directed right ascension angle, in degrees, for search or target acquisition.

dec.description: The expected or directed declination angle, in degrees, for search or target acquisition.

az.description: The expected or directed azimuth angle, in degrees, for search or target acquisition.

el.description: The expected or directed elevation angle, in degrees, for search or target acquisition.

range.description: The expected acquisition range or defined center range, in km.

extentAz.description: The extent of the azimuth angle, in degrees, from center azimuth to define a spatial volume.

extentEl.description: The extent of the elevation angle, in degrees, from center elevation to define a spatial volume.

extentRange.description: The extent of the range, in km, from center range to define a spatial volume.

lat.description: WGS-84 latitude, in degrees. -90 to 90 degrees (negative values south of equator).  If an accompanying stopLat is provided, then the lat value can be assumed to be the starting latitude of a volume definition.

yAngle.description: The angular distance, in degrees, in the sensor-y direction from scan center defined by the central vector.  The specification of xAngle and yAngle defines a rectangle of width 2*xAngle and height 2*yAngle centered about the central vector.

orientAngle.description: The magnitude of rotation, in degrees, between the xAngle direction and locally defined equinoctial plane.  A positive value indicates clockwise rotation about the sensor boresight vector.

stateVector.description: This service provides operations for querying and manipulation of state vectors for OnOrbit objects. State vectors are cartesian vectors of position (r) and velocity (v) that, together with their time (epoch) (t), uniquely determine the trajectory of the orbiting body in space. J2000 is the preferred coordinate frame for all state vector positions/velocities in UDL, but in some cases data may be in another frame depending on the provider and/or datatype. Please see the 'Discover' tab in the storefront to confirm coordinate frames by data provider.

idStateVector.description: Unique identifier of the record, auto-generated by the system.

classificationMarking.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

epoch.description: Time of validity for state vector in ISO 8601 UTC datetime format, with microsecond precision.

pedigree.description: The pedigree of state vector, or methods used for its generation to include state update/orbit determination, propagation from another state, or a state from a calibration satellite (e.g. ORBIT_UPDATE, PROPAGATION, CALIBRATION, CONJUNCTION, FLIGHT_PLAN).

idOnOrbit.description: Unique identifier of the satellite on-orbit object, if correlated. For the public catalog, the idOnOrbit is typically the satellite number as a string, but may be a UUID for analyst or other unknown or untracked satellites.

satNo.description: Satellite/Catalog number of the target OnOrbit object.

origObjectId.description: Optional identifier provided by state vector source to indicate the target onorbit object of this state vector. This may be an internal identifier and not necessarily map to a valid satellite number.

idOrbitDetermination.description: Unique identifier of the OD solution record that produced this state vector. This ID can be used to obtain additional information on an OrbitDetermination object using the 'get by ID' operation (e.g. /udl/orbitdetermination/{id}). For example, the OrbitDetermination with idOrbitDetermination = abc would be queries as /udl/orbitdetermination/abc.

msgTs.description: Time when message was generated in ISO 8601 UTC format with microsecond precision.

uct.description: Boolean indicating this state vector was unable to be correlated to a known object. This flag should only be set to true by data providers after an attempt to correlate to an OnOrbit object was made and failed. If unable to correlate, the 'origObjectId' field may be populated with an internal data provider specific identifier.

xpos.description: Cartesian X position of the target, in kilometers, in the specified referenceFrame. If referenceFrame is null then J2K should be assumed.

ypos.description: Cartesian Y position of the target, in kilometers, in the specified referenceFrame. If referenceFrame is null then J2K should be assumed.
